	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, dFecha, cNro_Externo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, lEditar
		Local nEstado,vGrabacion,cAliasAnt,nRegAnterior, nCol, mmpp
		
		Dimension vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.Clave = cId_Sucursal + cId_Sistema + cId_Comproba + STR(nNro_Referencia,10)
		thisform.Comproba = cId_Comproba
		thisform.Sucursal = cId_Sucursal
		thisform.Sistema  = cId_Sistema
		thisform.Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		
		thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Clave)
		nEstado = thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Op_Cerrada")
		
		if type("thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos") <> T_OBJECT
			thisform.AddObject("oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos"	,"Tg_ViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos", nEstado)
		endif
		
		If cId_Sistema = "C" 
			If Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba, .F., "CLAVE") And Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("ColumnasFormInsumos") > 0
				Thisform.Columnas = Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("ColumnasFormInsumos") + 3
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ColumnCount = Thisform.Columnas
				
				nCol = 3
		
				If Thisform.Columnas > 3 
					For nCol = nCol + 1 To Thisform.Columnas
						thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(nCol).Header1.Caption 	= "(          )"
						thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(nCol).Header1.Alignment 	= 0
						thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(nCol).Width				= 60
						ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Columns(nCol).Text1.Alignment 	= 0
					Next
				Endif
				
				For mmpp=1 to ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ColumnCount
					Dimension thisform.tg_Grid1.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]
					thisform.tg_Grid1.vAnchoColumnas[mmpp]=thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).Width
				EndFor
		
			Else 
				Thisform.Columnas = 3
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ColumnCount = Thisform.Columnas
			Endif
		Endif
			
		
		if lEditar  && se pueden AGREGAR O BORRAR RENGLONES Y DEMAS
			thisform.oCmdBorrar.Enabled 	   = .t.
			thisform.oCmdAgregar.Enabled 	   = .t.
			thisform.oCmdGrabar.Enabled 	   = .t.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ReadOnly = .f.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ReadOnly = .f.
		else
			thisform.oCmdBorrar.Enabled 	   = .f.
			thisform.oCmdAgregar.Enabled 	   = .f.
			thisform.oCmdGrabar.Enabled 	   = .f.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ReadOnly = .t.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ReadOnly = .t.
		endif	
		
		if thisform.oTblSistemas.Buscar (cId_Sistema)
			thisform.oTbxSistema.CAPTION = thisform.oTblSistemas.Leer("Nombre")
		endif
		
		thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption 	 = cId_Comproba
		thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption 	 = cId_Sucursal
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption  = alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		thisform.oTbxExterno.Caption 	 = cNro_Externo
		thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption 		 = dtoc(dFecha)
		thisform.oTbxId_Articulo.Caption = cId_Articulo
		thisform.oTbxCantidad.Caption    = alltrim(str(nCantidad,15,4))
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia)
		cAliasAnt=thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Seleccionar()
				
		index on id_articuloOp+id_articuloMp tag clave
		set order to tag clave
		If alltrim(cAliasAnt)<>""
			Select(cAliasAnt)
		Endif
		
		
		Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero
		Do While !Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof()
			cId_articuloOpAnt=Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("id_articuloOp")
			nRegAnterior=Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Recno()
			
			If Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Nro_referencia")<>0
			    thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloOpAnt)
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre",alltrim(cId_ArticuloOpAnt)+space(3)+alltrim(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_ArticuloOp",cId_ArticuloOpAnt)		
				Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif	
			
			Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrRegistro(nRegAnterior)
			
		    Do While cId_articuloOpAnt=Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("id_articuloOp") and !Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof()
		
				Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrSiguiente
					
			Enddo
		
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp, nCol
		
		nCol = 3
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Id_ArticuloMP"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Cantidad"
		
		If Thisform.Columnas > 3 
			For nCol = nCol + 1 To Thisform.Columnas
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(nCol).ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Separador"
			Next
		Endif
		                                                                                             
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lContinua
		lContinua = .t.
		
		thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof() and lContinua
		
			thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar (thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Id_ArticuloMP"))
			if !thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("MateriaPrima")
				=fMensAceptar ("El Artículo: " + thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo") + " no es MATERIA PRIMA, verifique!.")
				lContinua = .f.
			endif
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		return lContinua
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarimportes
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGrabar.Click
		if thisform.Validar()  && se valida que TODOS LOS ARTICULOS SEAN DE MATERIA PRIMA
			thisform.Grabar()
			thisform.Hide()
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor, lSuma, dFecha
		dodefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSerializacionDetalle"	,"tg_tabla", "SerializacionDetalle", "COMPROBA")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSerializacionDetalle"	,"Tg_ViewSerializacionDetalleComproba")	
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSistemas"				,"tg_tabla", "Sistemas", "CLAVE")
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(thisForm.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer('Titulo') = 1,rgb(0,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(thisForm.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer('Titulo') = 1,rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
		EndFor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rearmarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, dFecha, cNro_Externo
		
		if thisform.oTblSistemas.Buscar (cId_Sistema)
			thisform.oTbxSistema.CAPTION = thisform.oTblSistemas.Leer("Nombre")
		endif
		
		thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption 	= cId_Comproba
		thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption 	= cId_Sucursal
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption = alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		thisform.oTbxExterno.Caption 	= cNro_Externo
		thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption 		= dtoc(dFecha)
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia)
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrPrimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Serie"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Metraje"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Nombre"
		                                                                                                           
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarimportes
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux
		
		*!*	Dimension vVectorAux [1,2]
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Código de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)) 
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Razón Social de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.RazonSocial.Value)) 
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [6,2]
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Comprobante "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Sucursal "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Sistema "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxSistema.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Número Referencia "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[5,1] = "Número Externo "
		this.vTitulos[5,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxExterno.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[6,1] = "Fecha "
		this.vTitulos[6,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption)
		
		dodefault()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdCancelar.Click
		thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor, lSuma, dFecha
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.cancela = .t.
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSerializacionDetalle"	,"tg_tabla", "SerializacionDetalle", "COMPROBA")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSerializacionDetalle"	,"Tg_ViewSerializacionDetalleComproba")	
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSistemas"				,"tg_tabla", "Sistemas", "CLAVE")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"				,"tg_tabla", "Articulos", "CLAVE")
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(thisForm.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer('Titulo') = 1,rgb(0,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(thisForm.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer('Titulo') = 1,rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
		EndFor
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rearmarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, dFecha, cNro_Externo, Cid_articulo,nprecio
		
		LOCAL Cnombre_articulo , nmetraje_total , ncantidad_serialiazada
		
		
		if thisform.oTblSistemas.Buscar (cId_Sistema)
			thisform.oTbxSistema.CAPTION = thisform.oTblSistemas.Leer("Nombre")
		ENDIF
		
		
		Cnombre_articulo  = ""
		if thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Cid_articulo)
		  Cnombre_articulo = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		Endif
		
		thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption 	= cId_Comproba
		thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption 	= cId_Sucursal
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption = alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		thisform.oTbxArticulo.Caption 	= Cid_articulo + " - " + ALLTRIM(Cnombre_articulo)
		thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption 		= dtoc(dFecha)
		
		
		thisform.tg_ancho.Caption = STR(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("ancho"),8,2)
		thisform.tg_alto.Caption = STR(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto"),8,2)
		thisform.tg_costo.Caption =  STR(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("costo"),10,2)
		thisform.tg_metros_default.Caption = STR(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("metros_default") ,8,2)
		thisform.tg_monedacosto.Caption =  thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("id_monedacosto") 
		thisform.tg_pu.Caption =  STR(nprecio,10,2)
		
		
		
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia)
		
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrPrimero
		
		
		**** 1796 13-08-2024
		Do While !thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.EsEof()
		    IF Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer("id_articulo")<>Cid_articulo
		    
		    Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Borrar
		      
		    Endif
		    
			Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrSiguiente
		ENDDO
		
		**** 1796 13-08-2024
		nmetraje_total = 0 
		ncantidad_serialiazada = 0
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.EsEof()
		    IF Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer("id_articulo")=Cid_articulo AND  Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer("metraje")<>0
		         nmetraje_total = nmetraje_total + Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Leer("metraje")
			     ncantidad_serialiazada = ncantidad_serialiazada + 1
		    Endif
			Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		thisform.tg_metraje_total.Caption=STR(nmetraje_total,10,2)
		thisform.tg_total.Caption=STR(ncantidad_serialiazada,10,2)
		
		***thisform.tg_costo_calculado.Caption = STR(nmetraje_total / ncantidad_serialiazada  * thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto"),12,2)
		
		
		*******20-08-2024
		*!*	thisform.tg_costo_calculado.Caption = STR(nmetraje_total * thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("costo")  / thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto") / ncantidad_serialiazada,12,2)
		
		*!*	thisform.costo_aplicar = STR(nmetraje_total * thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("costo")  / thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto") / ncantidad_serialiazada,12,2)
		
		
		********** 20-08-2024
		thisform.tg_costo_calculado.Caption = STR(nmetraje_total * nprecio  / thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto") / ncantidad_serialiazada,12,2)
		
		thisform.costo_aplicar = STR(nmetraje_total * nprecio / thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("alto") / ncantidad_serialiazada,12,2)
		
		
		
		Thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.IrPrimero
			
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Serie"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Metraje"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewSerializacionDetalle.Alias+".Nombre"
		                                                                                                           
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux
		
		*!*	Dimension vVectorAux [1,2]
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Código de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)) 
		*!*	=FGrabar(@vVectorAux, "Razón Social de Cliente", alltrim(thisform.RazonSocial.Value)) 
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [6,2]
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Comprobante "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Sucursal "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Sistema "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxSistema.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Número Referencia "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption)
		
		this.vTitulos[5,1] = "Número Externo "
		this.vTitulos[5,2] = " "
		
		this.vTitulos[6,1] = "Fecha "
		this.vTitulos[6,2] = alltrim(thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption)
		
		dodefault()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE abrirformimputacion
		IF Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Comproba)
			nCopias = Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Copias")
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmImputarCliente","TG_ImputacionCompras",Thisform.Id_Proveedor,Thisform.Id_sucursal,Thisform.Id_Sistema,Thisform.ID_comproba,Thisform.Nro_Referencia,nCopias,thisform.Id_grupoSucur,.T.)
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.WindowType = 1
		
		*!*	Thisform.IngresoImputacion = .T.
		*!*	Thisform.Imputado = .T.
		
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.Show()
		
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmdActualizar.Enabled = .T.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta( Thisform.Id_Proveedor,Thisform.Suma, Thisform.Fecha,,,,,,, Thisform.ValidarRangoFechas, Thisform.Id_Comproba )
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultacredito(Thisform.Id_Proveedor,!Thisform.Suma,Thisform.id_Gruposucur)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculargravado
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,nImp_Pendiente,nTotalComproba,nValorRetencion
		
		*!*	if nValorRetencion=1
		*!*	
		*!*	endif
		
		Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.Refrescar( cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia, nValorRetencion )
		
		
		Return Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.leer("Monto")*nImp_Pendiente / nTotalComproba
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularimporteparcialpagar
		LOCAL vDatos, nImportePago, lRetorna
		DIMENSION vDatos[1,2]
		
		nImportePago = 0
		
		IF thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("PorcAPagar") <> 0
			nImportePago = ROUND((thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe") * thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("PorcAPagar")) / 100, 2)
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Imp_Pendiente", nImportePago)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "lSeleccion"	 , .t.)
			thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vDatos, .f. ,.t.)
		ENDIF
		
		
		lRetorna = thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularretenciones
		local nImporte_Parcial, mmpp, vRetenciones, vImportes,lResul
		nImporte_Parcial= 0
		mmpp= 1
		**** david 12/01 ***
		lResul= .t.
		***  david 12/01 ***
		
		*Dimension vRetenciones[1,8]
		Dimension vRetenciones[1,10]
		Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]
		
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= 0
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= 0
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		
		
		If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("MostrarRetenciones")
			If Isnull(thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones) .Or. Type("thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones") <> "O"
				Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones","Tg_AbmRetenciones",thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, .F., thisform.RazonSocial.value, Thisform.Cuit)
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones.Consultar(thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, .F., thisform.RazonSocial.value, Thisform.Cuit)
			Endif	 
		  
			Thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones.Show()
		Endif	
		   
		
		
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrPrimero
		
		if thisform.ValidarImportes(.t.)
		
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		      if thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("lSeleccion")
		         if thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0
		           
			    	&& Modificacion para que convierta el importe aplicado a cada comprobante a la moneda base (pesos) para que sobre esta calcule las retenciones    
		           	
		           			   	
			        Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),1 ) && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),2 ) && Total Iva
			       	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),3 ) && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		           			   	
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2) && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total Iva
			       	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]=thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		
		
		
		           
		*!*	            Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),1 ) && Total Grabado
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),2 ) && Total Iva
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),3 ) && Total no gravado
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		
		            Dimension thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,15]
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,1]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,2]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,3]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,4]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,5]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]  && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,6]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]  && Total Iva 
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,7]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]  && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,8]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") && Pendiente
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,9]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe")       && Pendiente Original
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,10]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Externo") 
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,11]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Fecha")        && Fecha Comprobante
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,12] = thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Suma")        && Comprobante Suma o Resta
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,15] = thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba")+STR(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		
		            mmpp= mmpp+1
		
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		   
		   && 21-09-2005
		   if (thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal+thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal ) > 0
		      Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]
		   endif
		   
		   Dimension vImportes[1,4]
		   
		   vImportes[1,1] = 0
		   vImportes[1,2] = 0
		   vImportes[1,3] = 0
		   vImportes[1,4] = 0
		   
		   FOR I=1 TO ALEN(thisform.Vec_Importe,1)
		   	  vImportes[1,1] = vImportes[1,1] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,1]
		  	  vImportes[1,2] = vImportes[1,2] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,2]
		   	  vImportes[1,3] = vImportes[1,3] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,3]
		   	  vImportes[1,4] = vImportes[1,4] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,4]
		   	  
		   NEXT
		   
		   && 21-09-2005
		   thisform.oCstCalculodeRetenciones.CalcularRetencion( thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, thisform.Fecha_Pago, thisform.TotalMonedaPrincipal, @vImportes, @vRetenciones, Thisform.ValidarRangoFechas)
		   ** Lucas 07/04/2009
		*   Dimension thisform.Vec_Retenciones[alen(vRetenciones,1),9]
		   Dimension thisform.Vec_Retenciones[alen(vRetenciones,1),10]
		   ** Lucas 07/04/2009     
		   acopy( vRetenciones, thisform.Vec_Retenciones )
		   
		   thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .t.
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .t.
		   thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= 0
		
		*** david 12/01 *****
		   if type("thisform.Vec_Retenciones")<> "L"
		      
		      for i= 1 to alen(thisform.Vec_Retenciones,1)
		          thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value+thisform.Vec_Retenciones[i,3]
		      endfor
		      
		*!*	   else
		*!*	      =fMensAceptar("Operacion Invalida!, debe Definir un rubro de Retencion al proveedor Seleccionado o Falta definir los parametros de la Retencion para el Calculo")      
		*!*	      lResul= .f.
		   endif   
		else
		   lResul= .f.
		endif
		
		if !lResul
		      thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		      thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		      thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= 0
		endif
		***** david 12/01
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrargrilla
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
		
		local cFechaHasta, cFechaDesde,  cFechaHastaVto, cFechaDesdeVto
		
		
		cFechaDesde = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
			cFechaHasta = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHasta  =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
		endif
		
		cFechaDesdeVto = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_txbFechaVtoDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
			cFechaHastaVto = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHastaVto =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
		endif
		
		
		
		
		cFiltro = "BETWEEN(fecha,ctod('"+cFechaDesde+"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHasta+"'))" + "and BETWEEN(Fecha_Vto,ctod('"+cFechaDesdeVto +"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHastaVto +"'))"
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Desfiltrar()
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.filtrar(cFiltro)
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor, lSuma, dFecha,vAuxiliar, lValidarRangoFechas,cId_Comproba,cId_GrupoSucur,nReferencia
		** CHIARA 31/07/18 Agregué cId_GrupoSucur
		dodefault()
		
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstCalculodeRetenciones","tg_CalculodeRetenciones")
		thisform.AddObject("oProveedores","Tg_tabla","Proveedores","Clave")	
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComPenRetenciones","tg_ViewComPenProvRetenciones")
		** CHIARA 31/07/18
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCreditoaFavor","tg_ViewCreditoaFavorProveedor")
		** CHIARA 31/07/18
		thisform.AddObject("oViewValorItemsCompras","tg_ViewValorItemsCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oConvMonUniversal","tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_tabla","Parametros")	
		
		&& LUCAS 01/06/2016
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","CLAVE")	
		&& LUCAS 01/06/2016
		
		thisform.Recno=1
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
		Next
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ReadOnly=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.CurrentControl="Text1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.DynamicCurrentControl="iif( Not Empty(Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer('Imp_pendiente')),'Text1','Text1')"	
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ReadOnly=.f.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.CurrentControl="Text1"
		
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
		ThisForm.tg_txbFechaVtoDesde.value	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaDesde.value 	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value		= ctod("  /  /    ")
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta( cId_Proveedor, lSuma, dFecha,,,,,,@vauxiliar, lValidarRangoFechas, cId_Comproba )
		
		** CHIARA 31/07/18
		Thisform.Tg_CmdActualizar.Enabled = .F.
		Thisform.Id_Proveedor 	= cId_proveedor
		Thisform.Id_Comproba 	= cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal 	= oApp.CodSucursal()
		Thisform.Id_Sistema 	= oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
		Thisform.Nro_referencia = nReferencia
		Thisform.Fecha 			= dFecha
		Thisform.Suma 			= lSuma
		IF TYPE("cId_GrupoSucur") <> "L"
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = cId_GrupoSucur
		ELSE 
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = ""
		ENDIF 
		Thisform.Ingresoimputacion = .F.
		Thisform.Imputado = .F.
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultaCredito(cId_Proveedor,!lSuma,Thisform.Id_Gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		IF Thisform.oViewCreditoaFavor.Leer("Total") <> 0 AND Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("ImputacionPreviaComp")
			Thisform.Abrirformimputacion()
		ENDIF 
		** CHIARA 31/07/18
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<> "O"		 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)

		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rearmarconsulta
		lParameters nImp_Gravado, nImp_Iva, nImp_Retencion, nTotalImputado, vVec_CompRetenciones,vAuxiliar,dfecha
		local nPos,vGrabacion,cId_Mon_deuda
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nPos= 0
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrPrimero
		cId_mon_deuda=thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda")
		If type("vVec_CompRetenciones[1,15]")<>"L"
			Do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		           
			   for i= 1 to alen(vVec_CompRetenciones,1)
			       if vVec_CompRetenciones[i,15]=thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba")+STR(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)    
		
			      	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente", thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[i,8] )
			      	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion"   , .t.    )    				
			    	  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		       
		    	   endif
			   endfor
		 
			   thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente
			Enddo
		Endif	
		
		&& 21-09-2005
		
		thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nImp_Gravado, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, dFecha, @vAuxiliar),2)
		thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nImp_Iva, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, dFecha, @vAuxiliar),2)
		
		
		
		thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value=   nImp_Gravado
		thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value=       nImp_Iva
		thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= nImp_Retencion
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value=     nTotalImputado
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Proveedor, lSuma, dFecha, nImp_Gravado, nImp_Iva, nImp_Retencion, nTotalImputado, vVec_CompRetenciones,vAuxiliar, lValidarRangoFechas, cId_Comproba
		local cId_Proveedor,lSuma, nGrupoImputacion
		
		
		&& 21-09-2005
		nGrupoImputacion = 0
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		*Damedco
		local vGrabacion, i
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Dimension thisform.vCotizaciones[1]
		
		If Type("vAuxiliar")<>"L"
			acopy( vAuxiliar, thisform.vCotizaciones )
		Else
			thisform.vCotizaciones=.f.	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.oProveedores.Buscar(cId_Proveedor)
		thisform.id_Mon_deudaProveedor=thisform.oProveedores.leer("id_Moneda_Cta")
		thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value= cId_Proveedor
		thisform.RazonSocial.value    = thisform.oProveedores.leer("Razon_Social")
		Thisform.Cuit				  = thisform.oProveedores.leer("Cuit")
		thisform.Fecha_Pago= dFecha
		thisform.lSuma= lSuma
		Thisform.ValidarRangoFechas	  = lValidarRangoFechas
		thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value  = 0.00
		thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value      = 0.00
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value    = 0.00
		thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= 0.00
		
		&& 21-09-2005 Defini esta propiedad para acumular los pesos totales en moneda principal
		thisform.TotalMonedaPrincipal = 0.00
		thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal=0.00
		thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal=0.00
		
		
		    
		thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		thisform.lCancelar_RetAuto=  .t.
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Refrescar( cId_Proveedor, lSuma )
		
		&& LUCAS 01/06/2016 - INICIO - PARA QUE NO MUESTRE LOS COMPROBANTES DE OTRO GRUPO DE IMPUTACION
		Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		nGrupoImputacion = Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irprimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		
			If nGrupoImputacion <> Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
				Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Borrar()
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irprimero
		&& LUCAS 01/06/2016 - FIN - PARA QUE NO MUESTRE LOS COMPROBANTES DE OTRO GRUPO DE IMPUTACION
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* damedco aca es donde si hay un vector de comprobantes a pagar no le doy bola a la vista y la lleno con el vector
		if type("thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[1,1]")="C"
		   Do While !Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		      Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Borrar()
		      Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo
		   for i = 1 to alen(Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones,1)
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal",substr(Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,1],1,3))    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema","C")    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba",substr(Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,1],5,3))    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia",Val(substr(Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,1],8,10)))    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total",Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,4])    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Pendiente",.t.)  
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe",Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,6])    				  				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Externo",Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,2])    				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha",Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,3])  
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma",iif(lSuma,.f.,.t.))
		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Proveedor",cId_Proveedor)    							  				
		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente",Thisform.VecComPenRetenciones[i,7])    				  				
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lSeleccion",.t.)
		       thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		   next
		   thisform.lCancelar_RetAuto=  .f.
		endif
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irprimero
		*************
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		if type("nTotalImputado")= "N"
		   if nTotalImputado <> 0
		      && 21-09-2005 Agregue el vAuxiliar t la dfecha
		      thisform.RearmarConsulta(nImp_Gravado, nImp_Iva, nImp_Retencion, nTotalImputado, @vVec_CompRetenciones,@vAuxiliar,dfecha )      
		   endif
		endif
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsultacredito
		LPARAMETERS cId_Proveedor,lSuma,cId_gruposucur
		
		Thisform.oViewCreditoaFavor.Refrescar(cId_Proveedor,lSuma,cId_gruposucur)

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Id_Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Importe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Imp_Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".lSeleccion"
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".Fecha_Vto" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=  thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Alias+".PorcAPagar" 
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017                                                                                                          
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017                    
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irPrimero()
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017                    
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobante
		lParameters lValor, nSuma
		local vGrabacion, nCant_Pend
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		nCant_Pend= 0
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente",iif(lValor,thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe"),nCant_Pend))  
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcAPagar",iif(lValor,100,0))  				
		   
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
		thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
		thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tildarcomprobantes
		local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irPrimero()
		
		do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.esEof()
		
			if !empty(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe"))
			   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", thisFORM.lTodos )    				
			   thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
			   thisform.SeleccionarComprobante(thisFORM.lTodos)
		
			endif    
			
			thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarimportes
		lParameter lvalida
		local lResul, cMensaje,nImporte_Parcial,nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal,vAuxiliar,cId_mon_deuda
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		lResul= .t.
		cMensaje= ""
		nImporte_Parcial= 0
		nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal=0
		
		
		
		if !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		   nRegistro= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Recno()
		else 
		   nRegistro= 1
		endif   
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrPrimero
		cId_Mon_deuda=thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("id_mon_deuda")
		If Empty(cId_Mon_Deuda)
		   cId_Mon_Deuda=thisform.id_Mon_deudaProveedor
		Endif   
		if thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value >= 0 and thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value >= 0
		
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof() and lResul
		
		      if thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("lSeleccion")
		         if ( thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0 ) .and. ( thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe") >= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente")   )
		         
		         	**21-09-2005 convertir cada imp_pendiente a la moneda proncipal de parametros y ver como anda
		         	
		            nImporte_Parcial=nImporte_Parcial+ thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente")
					nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal=nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal+Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_Deuda")),2)            
		         else
		            cMensaje= "El importe a imputar de los comprobantes debe ser mayor a Cero, o "+chr(13)+;
		                      "el importe pendiente debe ser mayor o igual a el importe a imputar"
		            lResul= .f.        
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		   
		*!*	   if ( nImporte_Parcial= 0 ) .and. lResul And !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsTablaVacia()
		*!*	      cMensaje= "Debe seleccionar por lo menos un comprobante para calcular la Retencion"
		*!*	      lResul= .f.        
		*!*	   endif
		
		else
		   cMensaje= "El Importe Gravado e Importe Iva debe ser Mayor o Igual a Cero"
		   lResul= .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		acopy(thisform.vCotizaciones,vAuxiliar )
		
		thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, thisform.Fecha_pago, @vAuxiliar),2)
		thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, thisform.Fecha_pago, @vAuxiliar),2)
		
		
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value= nImporte_Parcial+thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value+ thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value 
		
		&& 21-09-2005 
		thisform.TotalMonedaPrincipal=nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal +thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal + thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal
		
		if !lResul and lvalida
		   =fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
		endif
		
		Return lResul
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validaritemscompras
		Local lContinua 
		
		lContinua = .T.
		
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrPrimero
		Do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof() And lContinua
		
			If thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("lSeleccion")
		 		If thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0 
		   
				   	&& LUCAS 18/04/2017 - VALIDO QUE TODOS LOS ITEMS TENGAN CARGADO UN TIPO VALOR RETENCION, SINO CORTO LA VALIDACION
					Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.Refrescar(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"), 0 )	       	
					Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.IrPrimero()
		
					If !Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.EsEof()
						lContinua = .F.
					Endif
				   	&& LUCAS 18/04/2017
			
		     	Endif
		     Endif
		     
		     thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Return lContinua 
	ENDPROC

		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Tg_checkbox1.InteractiveChange
		local vGrabacion, lHayCheck, nRegistro
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if !empty(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", this.value )    				
		   thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
		   thisform.SeleccionarComprobante(this.value)
		else
		   this.value= .f.
		endif    
		
		if !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		   nRegistro= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Recno()
		else 
		   nRegistro= 1
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.esEof() 
			IF thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.leer("lseleccion") 
				lHayCheck = .t.
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		IF lHayCheck 
			ThisForm.tg_btnTodos.Caption ="Desmarcar todos"
		ELSE
			ThisForm.tg_btnTodos.Caption ="marcar todos"
		endif
		
		thisform.lTodos = lHayCheck 
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		local lValida
		
		lValida=dodefault()
		
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado
			if thisform.Proveedor<>this.Value
				thisform.RefrescarFormulario
			endif	
		endif
		Return lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_txbCredito.LostFocus
		thisform.ValidarImportes( .f. )
		
		*thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbGravado.LostFocus
		thisform.ValidarImportes( .f. )
		thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbIva.LostFocus
		thisform.ValidarImportes( .f. )
		thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbRetencion.LostFocus
		thisform.ValidarImportes( .f. )
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cClave
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_Docu"          ,"Tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu"         ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_Cabecera"      ,"Tg_tabla","Cmp_Cabecera"     ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oSistemas"          ,"Tg_tabla","Sistemas"         ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oSucursales"        ,"Tg_tabla","Sucursales"       ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oRetenciones"       ,"Tg_tabla","Retenciones"      ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_RetImputacion" ,"Tg_tabla","Cmp_RetImputacion","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_RetCalculado"  ,"Tg_tabla","Cmp_RetCalculado" ,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Valores"       ,"Tg_tabla","Caj_Valores"      ,"Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas"  ,"Tg_tabla","Aux_CmpRetencionesAutomaticas")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas1" ,"Tg_tabla","Aux_CmpRetencionesAutomaticas")
		
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.SetearProp  ("BOT")
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas1.SetearProp ("BOT")
		
		
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		*!*		thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
		*!*		thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
		*!*	Next
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ReadOnly = .t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid2.ReadOnly = .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid2.ResaltarRenglon()
		
		thisform.LlenarGrilla(cClave)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE llenargrilla
		Lparameters cClave
		Local vGrabacion, cClaveAux
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Revertir()
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas1.Revertir()
		
		thisform.oTbxGrabado.Value = 0
		thisform.oTbxIva.Value     = 0
		
		if thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Buscar (cClave)
		
		
			thisform.oSistemas.Buscar   (thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
			thisform.oSucursales.Buscar (thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
			
			thisform.oTbxSucursal.Value   = thisform.oSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
			thisform.oTbxSistema.Value    = thisform.oSistemas.Leer("Nombre")
			
			thisform.oCmp_Docu.Buscar (thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
			thisform.oTbxComproba.Value   = thisform.oCmp_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
		
			thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value = thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			thisform.oTbxFecha.Value      = thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha")
			thisform.oTbxNumero.Value     = thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo")
		
			thisform.oTbxGrabado.Value = thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("A_CuentaGravado")
			thisform.oTbxIva.Value     = thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("A_CuentaIva")
			
			if thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Buscar (cClave)
				do while !thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.EsEof() and thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.EsClaveIgual()
					
					cClaveAux = thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Suc_Cruce") + thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce") +;
								thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce") + str(thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"),10)
								
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Sucursal"   		  , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Suc_Cruce"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Sistema"    		  , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Comproba"   		  , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Nro_Referencia"		  , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Imp_CanceladoGravado" , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Imp_CanceladoGravado"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Imp_CanceladoIva"     , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Imp_CanceladoIva"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Imp_CanceladoOtros"   , thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Imp_CanceladoOtros"))
		
					if thisform.oSistemas.Buscar (thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce"))
						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "NombreSistema"        , thisform.oSistemas.Leer("Nombre"))
					endif	
		
					if thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Buscar (cClaveAux)
						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Nro_Externo"   , thisform.oCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo"))
					endif
					
					thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.AgregaryModificar (@vGrabacion, .t.)
					thisform.oCmp_RetImputacion.IrSiguiente()
				enddo
			endif
		
			if thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Buscar (cClave)
				do while !thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.EsEof() and thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.EsClaveIgual()
		
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Valor"   		    , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Id_Valor"))
					if thisform.oCaj_Valores.Buscar (thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Id_Valor"))
						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "NombreValor"        , thisform.oCaj_Valores.Leer("Nombre"))
					endif
					
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Retencion"           , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Id_Retencion"))
					if thisform.oRetenciones.Buscar (thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Id_Retencion"))
						=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "NombreRetencion"    , thisform.oRetenciones.Leer("Nombre"))
					endif
					
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total_ARetener"		    , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Total_ARetener"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total_RetencionesAnt"   , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Total_RetencionesAnt"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total_PagosAnt" 	    , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Total_PagosAnt"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total_Periodo"          , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Total_Periodo"))
					=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total_RetencionPeriodo" , thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.Leer("Total_RetencionPeriodo"))
		
					thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas1.AgregaryModificar (@vGrabacion, .t.)
					thisform.oCmp_RetCalculado.IrSiguiente()
				enddo
			endif
		endif
		
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas1.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<> "O"		 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oAux_CmpRetencionAutomaticas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		*!*	Local cTexto,oLst
		
		*!*	If thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Pago")
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		*!*		Else
		*!*			Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*		thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
		*!*	Else
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
		*!*		Else
		*!*			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculargravado
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,nImp_Pendiente,nTotalComproba,nValorRetencion
		
		*!*	if nValorRetencion=1
		*!*	
		*!*	endif
		
		Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.Refrescar( cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia, nValorRetencion )
		
		
		Return Thisform.oViewValorItemsCompras.leer("Monto")*nImp_Pendiente / nTotalComproba
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularimporteparcialpagar
		LOCAL vDatos, nImportePago, lRetorna
		DIMENSION vDatos[1,2]
		
		nImportePago = 0
		
		IF thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("PorcAPagar") <> 0
			nImportePago = ROUND((thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe") * thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("PorcAPagar")) / 100, 2)
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Imp_Pendiente", nImportePago)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "lSeleccion"	 , .t.)
			thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Modificar(@vDatos, .f. ,.t.)
		ENDIF
		
		
		lRetorna = thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularretenciones
		local nImporte_Parcial, mmpp, vRetenciones, vImportes,lResul
		nImporte_Parcial= 0
		mmpp= 1
		**** david 12/01 ***
		lResul= .t.
		***  david 12/01 ***
		
		*Dimension vRetenciones[1,8]
		Dimension vRetenciones[1,10]
		Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]
		
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= 0
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= 0
		thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		
		
		If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("MostrarRetenciones")
			If Isnull(thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones) .Or. Type("thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones") <> "O"
				Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones","Tg_AbmRetenciones",thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, .F., thisform.RazonSocial.value, Thisform.Cuit)
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones.Consultar(thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, .F., thisform.RazonSocial.value, Thisform.Cuit)
			Endif	 
		  
			Thisform.oFrmAbmRetenciones.Show()
		Endif	
		   
		
		
		
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrPrimero
		
		if thisform.ValidarImportes(.t.)
		
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.EsEof()
		      if thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("lSeleccion")
		         if thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0
		           
			    	&& Modificacion para que convierta el importe aplicado a cada comprobante a la moneda base (pesos) para que sobre esta calcule las retenciones    
		           	
		           			   	
			        Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),1 ) && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),2 ) && Total Iva
			       	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),3 ) && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		           			   	
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2) && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total Iva
			       	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3],thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]=thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		
		
		
		           
		*!*	            Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),1 ) && Total Grabado
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),2 ) && Total Iva
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= thisform.CalcularGravado(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Total"),3 ) && Total no gravado
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		
		            Dimension thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,15]
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,1]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,2]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,3]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,4]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,5]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]  && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,6]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]  && Total Iva 
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,7]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]  && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,8]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") && Pendiente
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,9]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Importe")       && Pendiente Original
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,10]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Externo") 
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,11]= thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Fecha")        && Fecha Comprobante
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,12] = thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Suma")        && Comprobante Suma o Resta
		            thisform.Vec_CompRetenciones[mmpp,15] = thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Id_Comproba")+STR(thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		
		            mmpp= mmpp+1
		
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		   
		   && 21-09-2005
		   if (thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal+thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal ) > 0
		      Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]
		   endif
		   
		   Dimension vImportes[1,4]
		   
		   vImportes[1,1] = 0
		   vImportes[1,2] = 0
		   vImportes[1,3] = 0
		   vImportes[1,4] = 0
		   
		   FOR I=1 TO ALEN(thisform.Vec_Importe,1)
		   	  vImportes[1,1] = vImportes[1,1] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,1]
		  	  vImportes[1,2] = vImportes[1,2] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,2]
		   	  vImportes[1,3] = vImportes[1,3] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,3]
		   	  vImportes[1,4] = vImportes[1,4] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,4]
		   	  
		   NEXT
		   
		   && 21-09-2005
		   thisform.oCstCalculodeRetenciones.CalcularRetencion( thisform.Tg_proveedores1.value, thisform.Fecha_Pago, thisform.TotalMonedaPrincipal, @vImportes, @vRetenciones, Thisform.ValidarRangoFechas)
		   ** Lucas 07/04/2009
		*   Dimension thisform.Vec_Retenciones[alen(vRetenciones,1),9]
		   Dimension thisform.Vec_Retenciones[alen(vRetenciones,1),10]
		   ** Lucas 07/04/2009     
		   acopy( vRetenciones, thisform.Vec_Retenciones )
		   
		   thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .t.
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .t.
		   thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= 0
		
		*** david 12/01 *****
		   if type("thisform.Vec_Retenciones")<> "L"
		      
		      for i= 1 to alen(thisform.Vec_Retenciones,1)
		          thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value+thisform.Vec_Retenciones[i,3]
		      endfor
		      
		*!*	   else
		*!*	      =fMensAceptar("Operacion Invalida!, debe Definir un rubro de Retencion al proveedor Seleccionado o Falta definir los parametros de la Retencion para el Calculo")      
		*!*	      lResul= .f.
		   endif   
		else
		   lResul= .f.
		endif
		
		if !lResul
		      thisform.Tg_CmdResultado.enabled= .f.
		      thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		      thisform.Tg_TxbRetencion.value= 0
		endif
		***** david 12/01
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrargrilla
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
		
		local cFechaHasta, cFechaDesde,  cFechaHastaVto, cFechaDesdeVto
		
		
		cFechaDesde = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
			cFechaHasta = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHasta  =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
		endif
		
		cFechaDesdeVto = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_txbFechaVtoDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
			cFechaHastaVto = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHastaVto =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
		endif
		
		
		
		
		cFiltro = "BETWEEN(fecha,ctod('"+cFechaDesde+"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHasta+"'))" + "and BETWEEN(Fecha_Vto,ctod('"+cFechaDesdeVto +"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHastaVto +"'))"
		thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.Desfiltrar()
		Thisform.oViewComPenRetenciones.filtrar(cFiltro)
		** MATIAS L. 27/09/2017
	ENDPROC

		&& LUCAS 01/06/2016

		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly=.f.

	ENDPROC
