	PROCEDURE marcardesmarcarcosto
		SELECT cCursorArticulos
		GO top
		IF thisform.lmarcardesmarcarcosto 
			DO WHILE !EOF() 
				replace cCursorArticulos.act_costo WITH .t.
				SKIP 1
			ENDDO
		ELSE
			DO WHILE !EOF() 
				replace cCursorArticulos.act_costo WITH .f.
				SKIP 1
			ENDDO
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE marcardesmarcarprecio
		SELECT cCursorArticulos
		GO top
		IF thisform.lmarcardesmarcarprecio
			DO WHILE !EOF() 
				replace cCursorArticulos.act_precio WITH .t.
				SKIP 1
			ENDDO
		ELSE
			DO WHILE !EOF() 
				replace cCursorArticulos.act_precio WITH .f.
				SKIP 1
			ENDDO
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE modificarcaption
		LOCAL lDesmarcarTodosCosto, lDesmarcarTodosPrecio
		lDesmarcarTodosCosto= .t.
		lDesmarcarTodosPrecio = .t.
		
		SELECT cCursorArticulos
		GO top
		DO WHILE !EOF() 
			IF !cCursorArticulos.act_costo
				lDesmarcarTodosCosto = .f.
				thisform.obtnCosto.Caption = "Marcar todos los costos"
				thisform.lmarcardesmarcarcosto = .t.
			endif
			SKIP 1
		ENDDO
		
		IF lDesmarcarTodosCosto
			thisform.obtnCosto.Caption = "desmarcar todos los costos"
			thisform.lmarcardesmarcarcosto = .f.
		ENDIF
		
		SELECT cCursorArticulos
		GO top
		DO WHILE !EOF() 
			IF !cCursorArticulos.act_precio
				lDesmarcarTodosPrecio = .f.
				thisform.obtnprecio.Caption = "Marcar todos los precios"
				thisform.lmarcardesmarcarprecio = .t.
			endif
			SKIP 1
		ENDDO
		
		IF lDesmarcarTodosPrecio 
			thisform.obtnprecio.Caption = "desmarcar todos los precios"
			thisform.lmarcardesmarcarprecio = .f.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE recuperarvector
		LPARAMETERS vInformacion
		LOCAL nContador
		nContador = 1
		
		SELECT cCursorArticulos 
		GO top
		DO WHILE !EOF()
			DIMENSION vInformacion[nContador ,6]
			vInformacion[nContador ,1] = cCursorArticulos.id_articulo
			vInformacion[nContador ,2] = cCursorArticulos.act_precio
			vInformacion[nContador ,3] = cCursorArticulos.act_costo
			vInformacion[nContador ,4] = cCursorArticulos.nombre
			vInformacion[nContador ,5] = cCursorArticulos.costonuevo
			vInformacion[nContador ,6] = cCursorArticulos.costoviejo
		 	nContador = nContador +1
			SELECT cCursorArticulos 
			SKIP 1
		ENDDO
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		LPARAMETERS vValores
		LOCAL vValoresCursor
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource			= ""
		
		DIMENSION vValoresCursor[6,4]
		vValoresCursor[1,1]="Id_Articulo"
		vValoresCursor[1,2]="C"
		vValoresCursor[1,3]=15
		vValoresCursor[1,4]=0
		vValoresCursor[2,1]="Nombre"
		vValoresCursor[2,2]="C"
		vValoresCursor[2,3]=50
		vValoresCursor[2,4]=0
		vValoresCursor[3,1]="act_precio"
		vValoresCursor[3,2]="L"
		vValoresCursor[3,3]=0
		vValoresCursor[3,4]=0
		vValoresCursor[4,1]="ACT_COSTO"
		vValoresCursor[4,2]="L"
		vValoresCursor[4,3]=0
		vValoresCursor[4,4]=0
		vValoresCursor[5,1]="CostoNuevo"
		vValoresCursor[5,2]="N"
		vValoresCursor[5,3]=12
		vValoresCursor[5,4]=2
		vValoresCursor[6,1]="CostoViejo"
		vValoresCursor[6,2]="N"
		vValoresCursor[6,3]=12
		vValoresCursor[6,4]=2
		
		
		create cursor cCursorArticulos from array vValoresCursor
		
		delete all in cCursorArticulos 
		
		For i = 1 to Alen(vValores,1)
		    append blank in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace id_Articulo with vValores[i,1] in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace Nombre      with vValores[i,4] in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace act_precio	with vValores[i,2] in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace ACT_COSTO	with vValores[i,3] in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace CostoNuevo	with vValores[i,5] in cCursorArticulos 
		    Replace CostoViejo	with vValores[i,6] in cCursorArticulos 
		endfor
		
		thisform.ncantidadregistros = Alen(vValores,1)
		
		SELECT cCursorArticulos
		GO top
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType		= 1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource			= ""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource			= "cCursorArticulos"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.id_Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.ACT_COSTO"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.act_precio"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.CostoViejo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource	= "cCursorArticulos.CostoNuevo"
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		thisform.modificarcaption()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		LPARAMETERS vArticulos
		thisform.refrescarGrilla(@vArticulos)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnCosto.Click
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
		thisform.marcardesmarcarcosto()
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE obtnGrabarSalir.Click
		thisform.grabo = .t.
		thisform.modificarcaption()
		thisform.Hide 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oBtnPrecio.Click
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
		thisform.marcardesmarcarprecio()
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Tg_checkbox1.Click
		THISFORM.modificarcaption()
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE agregar
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Agregar ()
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.text1.Enabled = .t.
			
		*thisform.oTblAuxCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Agregar()
		thisform.Tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE borrar
		
		
		if thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Formula_Inicial")
			=fMensAceptar("El Artículo no se puede borrar pertenece a la Fórmula Inicial!!!")
		else 
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Borrar()
		Endif
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculatotalcantidad
		
		thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof()
		
			thisform.TotalCantidad.Value=thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Sumar("Cantidad",".t.")	
			
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculatotaldesvios
		Local lTodoCero
		
		lTodoCero = .t.
		
		
		thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof()
			if thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Desvio") <> 0
				lTodoCero = .f.
			Endif
			
			thisform.TotalDesvios.Value=thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Sumar("Desvio",".t.")	
			
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarretencionesautomaticas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, dFecha, cNro_Externo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, lEditar , nEstado, cProveedor, lModificar, lHabilitarBotones
		Local vGrabacion,cAliasAnt,nRegAnterior
		
		Dimension vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.Clave 				= cId_Sucursal + cId_Sistema + cId_Comproba + STR(nNro_Referencia,10)
		thisform.Comproba 			= cId_Comproba
		thisform.Sucursal 			= cId_Sucursal
		thisform.Sistema  			= cId_Sistema
		thisform.Referencia 		= nNro_Referencia
		thisform.EstadoOP			= nEstado
		Thisform.Proveedor 			= cProveedor	
		thisform.Edita				= lEditar
		thisform.Modifico			= lModificar
		Thisform.HabilitarBotones	= lHabilitarBotones
		
		if type("thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos") <> T_OBJECT
			thisform.AddObject("oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos"	,"Tg_ViewCmp_ProduccionInsumosDesvios")
		endif
		
		
			
		if thisform.oTblSistemas.Buscar (cId_Sistema)
			thisform.oTbxSistema.CAPTION = thisform.oTblSistemas.Leer("Nombre")
		endif
		
		thisform.oTbxComproba.Caption 	 = cId_Comproba
		thisform.oTbxSucursal.Caption 	 = cId_Sucursal
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Caption  = alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		thisform.oTbxExterno.Caption 	 = cNro_Externo
		thisform.oTbxFecha.Caption 		 = dtoc(dFecha)
		thisform.oTbxId_Articulo.Caption = cId_Articulo
		thisform.CantidadPT			     = nCantidad
		thisform.oTbxCantidad.Value      = nCantidad
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia)
		
		Thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Id_ArticuloMP"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Alias+".Desvio"
		                    	 
		                                                                                                          
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.calculatotalCantidad()
		thisform.calculatotalDesvios()
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGrabar.Click
		
		*!*	if thisform.Validar()  && se valida que TODOS LOS ARTICULOS SEAN DE MATERIA PRIMA
		*!*		if !thisform.Modifico and !thisform.Edita
		*!*			thisform.Grabar()
		*!*		else
		*!*			if thisform.EstadoOP = 2
		*!*				thisform.CambiarEstado()
		*!*			Else
		*!*				if thisform.EstadoOP = 3
		*!*					oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)			
		*!*						thisform.GrabarModificacionOPCerrada()
		*!*						Thisform.lSeModifico = .t.
		*!*					oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId,.f.)					
		*!*				Else
		*!*					thisform.Modificar()
		*!*				Endif				
		*!*			Endif			
		*!*		Endif		
		*!*		thisform.Hide()
		*!*	Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		local vVectorAux
		
		Dimension this.vTitulos [13,2]
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Comprobante ........:  "

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdCancelar.Click

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion,nCantidadPT,cComAutOP,nNroAutOP,lAf_Merma
		
		Dimension vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		if Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.Sucursal+thisform.Sistema+thisform.Comproba+str(thisform.Referencia,10))
			cComAutOP	=   Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("id_com_aut_op")
			nNroAutOP	=	Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("nro_aut_op")
		Endif
		
		lAf_Merma = .f.
		
		if thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cComAutOP,.f.,"Clave")
			lAf_Merma	= thisform.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Af_Merma")
		Endif
		
		
		
		nCantidadPT = 0
		nCantidadPT = ThisForm.oTbxCantidad.Value
		
		
		thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.EsEof()
			
			if lAf_Merma
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"		,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT + (thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT * thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Porc_Merma") / 100 ))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Cant_con_merma" ,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT + (thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT * thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Porc_Merma") / 100 ))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Cant_sin_merma" ,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT )
			else
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"			,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT)
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Cant_con_merma" ,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT + (thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT * thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Porc_Merma") / 100 ))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Cant_sin_merma" ,thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Leer("Cant_Formula_Inicial") * nCantidadPT )		
			Endif
			
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Modificar (@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Tg_articulos1.LostFocus
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		if thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar (this.Value)
			=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Nombre", thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
			thisform.oViewCmp_ProduccionInsumos.Modificar (@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
		endif
		
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

		else 
			this.Enabled = .t.
		Endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC
